source.name: FC Shakhtar official online shop: 2026/27 FC Shakhtar Puma FCSD SCM Home Authentic Jersey
source.note: The club shop's 2026/27 home-shirt product page: product option 'Sponsor: SCM', model year 2026/27, and the details list 'FC Shakhtar Logo / SCM Logo / PUMA Cat Logo'. The club's kit-launch photos show the white SCM logo central on the chest of the orange-and-black striped home shirt; the back carries no sponsor.
source.quote: 2026/27 FC Shakhtar Puma FCSD SCM Home Authentic Jersey

source.name: FC Shakhtar: New Shakhtar kits: PUMA presents the 2026/27 outfit
source.note: Kit maker, named by the club as its technical partner in the 2026/27 kit launch; not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense.
source.quote: FC Shakhtar and the club's technical partner, global sports brand PUMA, present the new 2026/27 kits.

source.name: FC Shakhtar: Shakhtar and BETON: new title sponsor of the club
source.note: The club's title sponsor since May 3, 2026 on a three-year contract. The announcement says only that 'the sponsorship includes the placement of the BETON logo on part of Shakhtar's kit'; no BETON logo is visible on the 2026/27 kit-launch photos or the club shop's home-shirt product page (which names only SCM and Puma), so no specific shirt placement is claimed here.
source.quote: Under the terms of the three-year contract, the brand receives the status of the club's title sponsor.

summary: Puma home shirt: SCM on the front of the orange-and-black striped jersey; the club shop names no other sponsor on the shirt and the kit-launch photos show none on the back or sleeves. Beton is the club's title sponsor off the pitch, with its logo placed 'on part of Shakhtar's kit' per the May announcement. SCM is solely owned by Rinat Akhmetov, Beton is a private Ukrainian gambling operator, Puma is a listed company.
